title: Computational design of multi-topology lattice structures
context: My research explores computational approaches to designing lattice structures with different unit-cell topologies. During postdoctoral work at Zhejiang University, I developed a unit-cell library to support this design process. The resulting collaborative research was published in Mechanics Based Design of Structures and Machines.
contribution: During my postdoctoral appointment at Zhejiang University, from August 2021 to July 2023, I developed a unit-cell library to support multi-topology lattice design. This was collaborative research with Shurong Zhuo, Dongying Fu and Shuming Gao.
problem: Lattice design requires selecting and combining unit-cell geometries to meet engineering objectives. This research explores multi-topology lattice structures supported by a high-quality unit-cell library.
outputs: A collaborative paper published in 2024; the publication year is distinct from the postdoctoral appointment period.
